item.title: Word of the Day: Castigate
item.description: Phonetic: /cas·ti·gate/Part of Speech: VerbDefinition: reprimand (someone) severely. “he was castigated for not setting a good example”Similar: reprimand, rebuke, admonishThe judge castigated the lawyers for their lack of preparation.
